units.notes: The coordinate scale and tick duration have not been established; values below are coordinate units per hero update, not pixels per second.

tick_rate.notes: The scheduling loop has not been traced.

walk.notes: Keyboard movement assigns -8 or +8 to the hero horizontal input field; state 0 adds that field to the horizontal coordinate. Boundary checks may interrupt movement.

climb.notes: The ladder state changes the vertical coordinate by +10 or -10 per update, except when a boundary transition clamps it.

jump.notes: Each row is four signed 16-bit words: horizontal displacement magnitude, vertical displacement, frame index, vertical drawing adjustment. Horizontal displacement changes sign with facing. The negative first word terminates the sequence; boundaries and collisions can truncate it. Selection uses horizontal and vertical input fields.

fall.notes: This describes entry through CODE 2:0x1494 and the subsequent falling state; collision checks may end or clamp the fall.

lives.notes: Initialization and extra-life rules not yet traced.

shield_and_fireball.notes: Rules and inventory effects not yet traced.

creatures.notes: Individual creature speed, hit points, score index and animation order not yet traced.
